target_customer: Online publishers and content creators who want standardized attribution metadata on their content
problem: Online content is copied and shared without consistent attribution, and publishers lacked a standard, automated way to embed and track who created it.
business_model: SaaS subscription for attribution metatags; a third party directory lists pricing from 29 dollars per month

founders.name: Ela Madej
founders.background_notes: YC bio: founder and investor, co-founder and partner at Fiftyyears.

founders.background_notes: No bio on the YC page.

founders.background_notes: No bio on the YC page.

technical_complexity.rationale: Generating metadata tags and a lookup service is standard web engineering; the hard part is adoption of a standard.

defensibility.rationale: Open attribution formats such as hNews and rNews already existed, so a proprietary tag had little protection.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Open microformat standards for news attribution were adopted by hundreds of sites by 2010 and 2011, reducing room for a separate commercial tag.

market_need_then: Publishers were adopting hNews and rNews metadata and tracking vendors like Attributor sold content monitoring to the AP and Reuters, showing interest in attribution, though demand for a paid tag for general content is not evidenced.

brand_strength.rationale: No press, community or brand pages found; searches returned only unrelated credit brands.

outcome_analysis: Credictive was a YC Summer 2012 company offering attribution metatags for online content, started by a team that included a serial founder of BaseCRM and Applicake. Open standards such as hNews and rNews already covered news attribution, and no traction, funding or press was found. The cause of the company becoming inactive is not public, so failure factors stay empty.
notes: No company website is listed in the data, and no site was fetched. Searches for outcome, funding, a Crunchbase total, branding and competitors found no company-specific press. The hNews and rNews pages are used as context for the market, not as direct competitors with dated launch coverage naming Credictive, so the competitor list is left empty. Founding year not stated by a source I opened. Founder education and prior employers are not on the YC page.
